empty.description: Create your first Cairn project to start multi-agent collaboration experiments. Cairn uses a blackboard architecture where multiple agents write shared facts, propose hints, and take on subtasks to collaboratively reason and divide work. Fill in an origin, goal, and optional hints to define the task; the system coordinates workflows and maintains an auditable decision record.
